domicile_punjab.who: Pakistani citizens living in a Punjab district. Minors apply through father or guardian.
domicile_punjab.where: Nearest e-Khidmat Markaz in your district. The file goes to the Assistant Commissioner office, which prints and signs the certificate and returns it to the e-Khidmat Markaz.

fee.breakdown: Rs 200 domicile fee + Rs 300 e-stamp (affidavit) + Rs 50 PITB service charge
fee.payment: Paid digitally through the ePay Punjab app
fee.note: New fee approved by the Punjab cabinet in August 2026. Earlier it was Rs 200 by challan.

documents.en: Applicant's CNIC (or B-Form if under 18) - original and copy
documents.ur: درخواست گزار کا شناختی کارڈ (18 سال سے کم ہو تو ب فارم) - اصل اور کاپی
والد یا سرپرست کے شناختی کارڈ کی کاپی

documents.en: Proof of residence in the district (utility bill or property papers)
documents.ur: ضلع میں رہائش کا ثبوت (بجلی/گیس کا بل یا جائیداد کے کاغذات)

documents.en: Matric certificate or school leaving certificate (for date of birth and schooling)
documents.ur: میٹرک سرٹیفکیٹ یا اسکول لیونگ سرٹیفکیٹ

documents.en: Affidavit on e-stamp paper (part of the Rs 550 fee)
documents.ur: ای اسٹامپ پر بیان حلفی (550 روپے فیس میں شامل)

steps: Collect the documents in the checklist.
Pay Rs 550 through the ePay Punjab app.
Visit the nearest e-Khidmat Markaz with originals and copies; biometric verification is done there.
Keep the tracking ID; track on the e-Khidmat website or app.
Collect the certificate from the e-Khidmat Markaz (courier delivery to home is being introduced).

sources.name: Higher Education Dept Punjab - Student Affairs

domicile_punjab.disclaimer: Requirements can change. Confirm at your e-Khidmat Markaz before visiting.
